title: Governed WordPress Staging exact-artifact deployment v2

phases.objective: Bind the exact-artifact WordPress Staging deployment plane to canonical environment-impact governance without granting or executing Production mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate the exact PR candidate against the canonical environment-impact policy before any live Staging deployment.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Shared runtime impact is explicitly reviewed for Staging and Production, live Staging certification remains required, and Production mutation remains denied.
steps: Classify exact base-to-head source changes against canonical environment path classes.
Verify the declaration includes every required environment target and preserves cross-environment review.
Verify live Staging certification remains required for the shared runtime deployment surface.
Verify Production mutation, provider mutation, database mutation, credential payload reads, and Production deployment remain denied.
Resolve server-owned SSH credentials without creating credential-intake handoffs; fail closed before any SSH connection when a required role is unresolved.
After a successful deployment and exact same-cycle readback, classify capability-envelope consumption failure as governance reconciliation and explicitly forbid deployment retry.
Complete artifact, plugin-version, and same-filesystem validation before arming plugin rollback; pre-swap validation failure performs transient cleanup only.
Preserve any pre-existing WordPress maintenance-mode state across successful deployment and rollback.
Require apply_allowed=true and persist the exact capability-envelope reference before the first artifact upload.
assertions: Staging and Production are both declared as impacted targets because shared runtime source files changed.
Cross-environment review is explicit and live Staging certification remains required.
No Production deployment, database mutation, provider mutation, or credential payload read is authorized by this declaration.
Missing server-owned SSH credentials fail with remote_runtime_server_owned_ssh_credential_not_resolved before any SSH connection attempt.
Credential resolution for this deployment surface never auto-creates a credential-intake handoff and never accepts caller-supplied credentials.

If deployment and exact readback succeed but envelope consumption fails, evidence records mutation_applied=true, retry_deployment=false, reconciliation_required=true, and capability_envelope_consumed=false.
The rollback ERR trap is armed only after remote validation and immediately before the first plugin-directory rename.
Pre-swap validation failure does not enter plugin rollback or toggle WordPress maintenance mode.
A pre-existing WordPress maintenance mode remains active after both successful deployment and rollback.
A successful authorized Hostinger target probe records remote_runtime_targets.validation_status=valid, matching the canonical target schema.
A valid but non-apply capability envelope cannot start WordPress deployment writes.
Envelope-reference persistence failure occurs before the first artifact upload and records first_remote_write_started=false.
